_comment: English commit messages for the en screenshot set, keyed by the short hash of the real commit in this repo. Missing entries keep the original (Korean) message.
b0c0713:
chore: scaffold Tauri + React app and role agents

- Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript project
- graph-engine / git-backend / ui-frontend role agents
59c74db:
chore: add shared contract, plan, and Phase 0 deps

- Rust <-> TS shared contract (src/types.ts) and PLAN.md
- dependencies for the first phase
c8c5f6d:
feat: Rust git backend, React UI, and contract test

- backend that runs the system git (log, branches, details, diff, basic writes)
- three-pane UI: branch tree, commit log table, details panel
- contract test that Rust output matches the TS types
f37e253:
feat: port vcs-log graph engine (normal + Bek sort)

- lane layout, edge generation, long-edge collapsing and colouring in TypeScript
- "Standard" (Bek) and Linear Bek sorting
4af84b2:
fix(backend): multi-repo isolation, literal pathspecs, op timeouts, streamed diff cap

- state no longer mixes between open repositories
- paths are taken literally (--literal-pathspecs)
- write-op timeouts; large diffs are capped while streaming
b571400:
feat(ui): repo tabs, instant tooltips, and review fixes

- open several repositories as tabs
- tooltips without delay
- review fixes
f36fe38:
feat: separate side-by-side diff window

- word-level highlight, jump between changes (F7) and files
c57275f:
fix(graph): order layout heads so Bek interleaves merged branches

- same branch priority as the upstream layout comparator
cba6a3e:
chore: rename to Lanes, add NOTICE and README

- NOTICE for the derived graph code and the full Apache-2.0 text
